thread:
anya: Quick sync — product webinar invite, free credits routing + onboarding prompt packs. Want to lock routing rules before we publish landing page.

matt: timeline?

anya: send invites Wed 10am PT, email + in-app nudge 10am PT. Landing live Tue EOD. Need routing map for inbound leads to PLG cohorts.

sofie: ok. do we do single-credit vs tiered credits for webinar attendees?

jordan: recommend tiered: 100 credit demo users, 300 for engaged signups (attended webinar). Measure activation at 7 days.

lina: agree tiered. question: where do webinar registrants who don't attend fall? auto drip + 50 credits after 48h?

anya: yes. plan: 
- registrant: 25 credits immediately
- attendee: +275 credits at webinar end
- demo requested: add 200 credits and assign to CS
We need routing rules for origin=webinar -> priority funnel=activation

matt: here's a draft routing rule:
```
if source == "webinar" and attended == true:
  assign_segment("attendee_high")
  credits=300
elif source == "webinar" and attended == false:
  assign_segment("registrant_drip")
  credits=25
```

sofie: nice. How does this interact with existing onboarding prompt packs? we don't want to overwrite template assignments.

anya: merge logic: prefer higher credit segment but keep prompt_pack if user already has one. We'll add a flag `preserve_prompt_pack=true` in routing.

jordan: can growth-bot create the segments and a quick CSV export so ops can import?

growth-bot: created segments: webinar_attendee_high, webinar_registrant_drip. CSV export link: https://drive.redwood.ai/exports/webinar_segments_1765432100.csv

lina: tagging @matt for landing UTM params. Need utm_source=webinar_invite, utm_campaign=may_launch.

matt: will update landing. Also triggering two experiments: A) send free credits immediately B) wait until post-webinar. Need tracking keys.

sofie: suggested tracking keys: experiment=invite_timing_v1/v2 and property `credits_flow`.

anya: closing loop — matt, can you push the routing rules to the automation playbook by Tue 5pm? Jordan, can you confirm CSV import works with ops?

matt: on it.

jordan: will test import today, report by EOD. :thumbsup: 

anya: perfect. we'll reconvene Mon morning for final QA. thanks everyone!
